gaps: www.hanyang.ac.kr returns HTTP 403 to all automated fetches (curl and WebFetch), so the main-site English scholarship/campus-life pages could not be read; facts come from oia.hanyang.ac.kr, the 2027 Spring guides, iie.hanyang.ac.kr and eng.dormitory.hanyang.ac.kr.
Guide publication_date: PDFs show no printed date (files uploaded to OIA filebox 2026-08-24 / 2026-08-26); left null. English guide used; the guide states the Korean version prevails.
Korean-language rule stage recorded as 'ENROLLMENT' (not in BRIEF's example values): both guides make TOPIK 4 a condition for starting the degree, not for applying.

Graduate English-track language requirements: guide says English certificates are 'Only necessary for the required department(including English Tracks)' and lists TOEFL iBT, IELTS, CEFR and other tests without per-department minimums; no graduate ENGLISH language_rules recorded.
Graduate English-taught programme list by level not captured (graduate admission-unit tables not transcribed); english_taught_degrees.levels lists BACHELOR only.
TOPIK Scholarship (registered students): benefit amount not stated in the guides.
ERICA campus: undergraduate guide covers Seoul campus; ERICA dormitory fees (hydorm.hanyang.ac.kr) and ERICA undergraduate international scholarships not researched.
Dormitory international_priority and capacity not stated.
GKS figures on OIA KGSP page are 'as of March 2024'; current NIIED amounts not verified.
IIE Korean programme tuition fee not captured.
No INTL_RECRUITMENT-type video (international-admissions promo) found on the official channel; English promo and LAN tour videos are 5–6 years old.
gpa_rule: not stated as a uniform admission minimum (undergraduate evaluation is document-based; graduate HISP uses GPA ≥80/100 only for the scholarship).
